$comment: Source of truth for scope and progress. One feature in-progress at a time. 'done' requires evidence: command, outcome, date.

features.name: Baseline scraper pipeline
features.description: Playwright scraper with Rappi location-cookie injection per zone, COP parser, DuckDB storage, CLI (run/stats/export/query), analysis report.
acceptance: Location cookie changes the stores returned per zone
main.py run stores snapshots; stats/export/query work
features.evidence: 2026-11-05: probe showed different store sets for El Poblado, Sabaneta and Bogotá with the cookie; initial run stored 171 rows (query 'hills perro').

features.name: Store-aware data model and views
features.description: Capture store_id/store_name/product_id from data-qa attributes; key snapshots by day+zone+store+product; pack_size from unit price; per-zone latest view; generic N-zone comparison; best-price-by-store view; trends per offer. ADR-001, ADR-002.
acceptance: No duplicate offers per day/zone/store/product
Zone comparison compares same product and pack size only
v1 database migrated without losing rows
features.evidence: 2026-11-05: .\run_weekly.ps1 from C:\Windows\System32 -> exit 0, 1,621 offers from 25 stores, 0 unparsed cards; legacy 171 rows kept in product_snapshots_legacy_v1; analysis.py sections 1-5 render; zone diffs 5-22% after pack_size.

features.name: Scheduled-run hardening
features.description: Project-root path resolution, Colombia local dates + ISO weeks, UTF-8 output, run_weekly.ps1 with cwd fix, transcript logs, exit codes; init.ps1 with fail-fast + tests; requirements as UTF-8 + requirements-dev.txt; pytest suite. ADR-006.
acceptance: run_weekly.ps1 works when launched from System32
init.ps1 stops on first failing step
features.evidence: 2026-11-05: run_weekly.ps1 from System32 exit 0; init.ps1 from System32 exit 0 (tests pass).

features.name: Cross-store product matching
features.description: Persisted product_key (normalized, order-insensitive name) with v2->v3 migration/backfill; views group by product_key + pack_size. ADR-003.
acceptance: Differently worded names of the same product share a key
Distinct variants (i/d vs k/d, mini vs medium, strengths) do not
Existing DB backfilled on open
features.evidence: 2026-11-05: pytest 47 passed (match_key merge/split cases, v2 backfill test); real DB backfilled 604 names -> 553 keys; cross-store matches 399 -> 404.

features.name: Markup-drift detection and relevance filter
features.description: RunResult tracks empty/failed queries and text-fallback cards; exit 2 when degraded; debug HTML+PNG dumps to logs/debug; drop results unrelated to the query. ADR-004, ADR-005.
acceptance: Degraded runs exit 2 and still export
Empty/unparseable pages are dumped to logs/debug
Fuzzy-matched unrelated products are not stored
features.evidence: 2026-11-05: pytest exit-code + fallback-flag tests pass; offline dump test wrote logs/debug/*.html/.png; .\init.ps1 -Smoke exit 0 (84/84 cards structured, 0 fallback); filter removed 203/1,621 existing rows, all 380 medical rows kept.

features.name: Register weekly Windows Task Scheduler job
features.description: Create the scheduled task (weekly, Wednesday 10:00 via register_task.ps1, ADR-008) running run_weekly.ps1 and confirm Last Run Result = 0 after the first scheduled execution.
acceptance: Task exists (Get-ScheduledTask) with the documented action
First run via Task Scheduler produces a complete logs/run_*.log and Last Run Result 0
features.evidence: 2026-11-05: user ran register_task.ps1 -> task 'Rappi Price Scraper (weekly)' registered, NextRunTime 2026-11-11 10:00. Start-ScheduledTask -> LastRunTime 12:44:24, LastTaskResult 0; 1,496 offers saved/updated (DB 1,422 rows, 382 medical), exports refreshed 12:47. Found PS 5.1 Start-Transcript dropping python output in hidden window; run_weekly.ps1 now writes every line to the log (UTF-8). Re-verified hidden from System32 with a 1-query temp config: exit 0, complete log.

features.name: Validate week-over-week trends with real data
features.description: After a second weekly run (>= 2026-11-09), check v_weekly_trends returns rows, store/product ids are stable across weeks, and pct_change values are plausible.
acceptance: v_weekly_trends non-empty after the second run
Spot-check 5 offers against Rappi
features.note: Unblocked 2026-11-11: scheduled run added a third run date.

features.name: Client store competitive diagnosis (VelykaPet, Itagüí)
features.description: Explain low Rappi sales of the client store 900483846 vs competitors: search visibility from her address, catalog breadth and availability, price index vs competitors on shared products, listing price vs in-store price, margins. Client sales data and findings live only in data/client/ (git-ignored).
acceptance: Visibility measured from the store's own coordinates for the queries her customers use
Price index vs competitors on shared products with matching pack size
Findings + recommendations delivered to the user; client answers to open questions recorded
Decision on turning the probes into a recurring client report -> F9
features.evidence: 2026-11-05: probes from the store coordinates (search visibility, catalog, competitor offers), contract and partner-portal review; diagnosis + recommendations delivered to the user. Private details only in data/client/.

features.name: Client pricing sheet + weekly visibility tracker
features.description: Private overlay config (config/settings.local.yaml) with client store/zone/queries; search_store_ranks + v_store_visibility; weekly crawl of the client catalog; client-report command: inventory <-> Rappi matching (ADR-010), commission-aware price suggestions, Spanish Excel (Resumen, Precios Rappi, Visibilidad, Visibilidad semanal, Supuestos); wired into run_weekly.ps1.
acceptance: Weekly run records store positions and the client catalog
client-report produces the Excel; matches reviewed for false positives
Already-cheapest products are never told to price above the competitor
No client data in committed files
features.evidence: 2026-11-05: pytest 74 passed (matching true/false pairs, pricing rules incl. already-cheapest, inventory loader, report sheets, overlay merge, header parsing); live: main.py run --zone <client zone> exit 0 (24 searches, catalog 21 products from 15 pages); main.py client-report exit 0 (123 product searches, 145 products, 58 matched, 13 published); manual review of matches; leak scan of committed files clean.

features.name: Client report: price sanity check, units per listing, stricter flavours
features.description: Fixes from review of the 2026-11-11 report: competitors priced outside 0.4-2.5x her direct price are flagged 'Revisar coincidencia' and not priced against; client.units_per_listing scales per-unit cost/price to the Rappi pack; flavour sets must be equal (more flavours, English mapped); sub-lines (pops/bites/rolls) must agree. ADR-011.
acceptance: Per-unit items configured as packs are compared pack-to-pack
Implausibly priced matches are shown but never drive the suggestion
Different flavours and sub-lines of the same brand do not match
No client data in committed files
features.evidence: 2026-11-11: .\init.ps1 exit 0, pytest 85 passed (new: flavour/sub-line false pairs, Churu true pairs, ratio check, pack hint, units_per_listing). main.py client-report --search none --out <v2> exit 0: only the configured pack items and the brand-less accessory changed; 56 matched (was 58, both removed matches were wrong).

features.name: Client report: 'Ajustar en Rappi' tab (her +20% rule)
features.description: Weekly tab comparing each of her linked Rappi listings (barcode -> product id, private overlay) with WhatsApp price x (1 + rappi_markup_pct): Subir/Bajar/OK, unlinked listings, linked listings missing, stock-0 notes; inventory_path glob picks the newest backup. ADR-012.
acceptance: Every listing in her live catalog appears in the tab (linked or 'Vincular')
Target follows her rule, including pack listings
Runs inside the weekly client-report with no manual step besides dropping a new backup in data/client/
No client data in committed files
features.evidence: 2026-11-11: .\init.ps1 exit 0, pytest 87 passed (new: markup rule actions, tolerance, pack target, unlinked/missing links, sheet order, newest-backup glob). main.py client-report --search none --out <v3> exit 0: 27 listings -> 13 OK, 9 Subir, 2 Bajar, 3 Vincular.

features.name: Hourly client visibility probe
features.description: main.py probe + run_probe.ps1 + register_probe_task.ps1 (hourly 09:15-20:15, daily, time-limited): her store page opens? + her rank in ~9 searches; separate DB; report tabs 'Visibilidad por hora' / 'Visibilidad hora a hora'. ADR-013.
acceptance: Probe writes only data/visibility_probe.duckdb and never runs in parallel with the weekly task
Task registered by the user and running hourly; logs in logs/probe_<date>.log
After the period: hourly summary delivered (when her store page opens, when she is listed) and task removed
features.evidence: 2026-11-11: .\init.ps1 exit 0, pytest 91 passed (new tests/test_probe.py: row building, declared hours/holidays, save/load idempotent, hourly summary, report sheets). Live: run_probe.ps1 exit 0 at 15:39 (store page redirected to directory; listed 1/9, #1 in control search). Scripts parse OK. Pending: user runs register_probe_task.ps1 (agent cannot create scheduled tasks).
